blind.B1: No. Same series as the acute case: doxorubicin cardiotoxicity with NMN. No sequenced group is exercised. Treadmill (S2.5.p1) and rotarod (S2.6.p1) were done at day 45 on cohort-2 and cohort-3 as outcome tests; RNA-seq was on 5-6 hearts per group of cohort-3 (S2.2.p4). Note that cohort-3 had the rotarod test, so the sequenced mice did a rotarod test, but it is a test, not a training arm, and is the same in all groups.
blind.B2: Chronic, day 60: Doxo vs Ctrl and Doxo-NMN vs Doxo (S3.6.p1). n = 5-6 per group (S2.2.p4, Fig 4 legend); GEO has 5 Vehicle / 6 Doxo / 6 Doxo-NMN.
blind.B3: No repeated measures: one heart per mouse, one time point. The title-suffix key is the replicate index; pairing_check not_supported (p=0.22).
blind.B4: S2.9.p1: edgeR TMM, estimateDisp, QL F-test. Joint versus pairwise is not stated.
blind.B5: S3.6.p1: 'We identified nine genes differentially expressed in Doxo vs. Ctrl and none in Doxo-NMN vs. Doxo (p.adj < 0.05).' No fold-change cutoff stated for the chronic study.

checks.evidence: No exercise factor among sequenced hearts; metadata treatment = Vehicle/Doxo/Doxo-NMN only; no exercise words in any column.
5/6/6 matches n = 5-6 per group (S2.2.p4); 17/17 aligned by normalised key.
One heart per mouse; title-suffix candidate is a replicate index and not supported (diff 0.07, p=0.22).
Integer fraction 1.0, featureCounts raw counts; edgeR recommended as in S2.9.p1.
FDR 0.05, no fold-change rule, as in S3.6.p1; the spec records effect cutoff null correctly (the acute 1.5 rule is not carried over).
HANDBACK quotes 9 and 0 DEGs as reference only.
'No exercise arm' holds and was checked against the paper. Suitability 'sample_size fail 0/0' is an artefact of no contrast being defined, not a real size problem (5/6/6).

human_items: Open policy question (not an error): whether drug-contrast series from papers with an exercise test outcome should get a labelled sensitivity run; the skill currently says refuse.
summary: 该系列(GSE221003 慢性组)测序的心脏样本只有 Ctrl/Doxo/Doxo-NMN,没有运动干预,跑步机和转棒只是表型检测,拒绝分析成立。分组 5/6/6、阈值(FDR 0.05,无倍数变化)、矩阵类型均与论文一致,仅有一个次要措辞问题。
